page.layout: One printed page: title block at full width at top; below it two columns of index entries (left column from A to Altaria, right column continuing to B and Babylon); a large woodcut initial A at the left of the first column. Running head at top faint, not legible enough to transcribe.

page.notes: The first column's initial A is a large woodcut ornament. Some page numbers and letters are faint or damaged; the running head at the top is too faint to read. The text "Baby=" at the foot is a catchword with a hyphen, as printed.
